## Appearance

Anne Shirley has a little pointed chin, a nice nose, and a face with a sweet expression. Her big, bright gray-green eyes are full of sparkle, and her vivid hair streams behind her in a bright torrent, though at one point it turned green.

## Personality

Anne Shirley is an imaginative and highly talkative individual who is also known to be generous, though at times she can be careless and reckless. Her vivid imagination allows her to find optimism even in bad situations, though she sometimes catches herself acting without reflection. Driven by strong desires, she wants to remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), grow up to be good-looking, and work toward becoming a teacher like Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), while at one point preferring to be called Cordelia. She demonstrates accountability by confessing her mistakes to take responsibility, such as when she resolved to confess a fault in order to attend a picnic.

## History

Raised as an adopted orphan without kith or kin, fourteen-year-old Anne Shirley arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) by mistake instead of the requested boy, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decided to keep her at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). During her early years, she vowed eternal friendship with [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) and once bought dye from a peddler that turned her red hair green, forcing [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to cut it off. Though she initially left school after being punished beside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she eventually returned under Miss Stacy's mentorship, earning her teaching certificate at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and staying home to manage [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) died and Marilla's sight failed. [Anne](../character/anne.md) taught at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and organized the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society)—enduring misadventures like selling Mr. Harrison's cow by mistake—before heading to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) with her friends. Early in her college years, she rejected a marriage proposal from [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) via his sister Jane, followed by a rejected proposal from [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), which fractured their close dynamic. While pursuing her studies, [Anne](../character/anne.md) successfully wrote short pieces for publication and spent two years courted by [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), whom she ultimately turned down upon realizing she did not love him. Learning that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) was near death from typhoid fever forced [Anne](../character/anne.md) to acknowledge her true feelings, leading to their reconciliation and engagement after his recovery. After graduating, [Anne](../character/anne.md) took a teaching position at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) for two years, and she later gathered with [Diana](../character/diana.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discuss her upcoming marriage to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and their planned move to [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor). Years later, after returning from a trip to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), [Anne](../character/anne.md) sat on the veranda at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) with [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) while her youngest children played nearby.

## Quotes

> "I’ll fold them nicely tonight. They always made us do that at the asylum. Half the time, though, I’d forget, I’d be in such a hurry to get into bed nice and quiet and imagine things."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P2](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0002)

> "I’d do anything to oblige you. But you’ll have to tell me what to say for this once. After I get into bed I’ll imagine out a real nice prayer to say always. I believe that it will be quite interesting, now that I come to think of it."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P15](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0015)

> "But I’d be ever so much gratefuller if—if you’d made just one of them with puffed sleeves. Puffed sleeves are so fashionable now. It would give me such a thrill, Marilla, just to wear a dress with puffed sleeves."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P9](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0009)

> "Oh, Marilla, I’m frightened—now that it has come I’m actually frightened. What if she shouldn’t like me! It would be the most tragical disappointment of my life."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P10](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0010)

> "I’ll just eat one tonight, Marilla. And I can give Diana half of them, can’t I? The other half will taste twice as sweet to me if I give some to her. It’s delightful to think I have something to give her."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P45](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0045)

## Relationships

### [Di](../character/di.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--di.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Di](../character/di.md) hit it off early in their youth after meeting at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), solemnly vowing in the garden to be best friends forever. They have remained close chums through every stage of growing up, sharing childhood antics, collaborative work for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), and quiet moments together before major life transitions like college.

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana.md)

[Diana](../character/diana.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) have been best chums and schoolmates since childhood. Though their early friendship faced a major hurdle when [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana.md) wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing Diana's mother to temporarily forbid them from playing together, [Anne](../character/anne.md) restored the bond by bravely saving Diana's sick sister. They have remained constant companions through school, domestic visits, and dramatic misadventures.

- Friend of — best chums and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XV. [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) began their relationship as bitter academic rivals, with [Anne](../character/anne.md) harboring intense personal resentment toward him despite his early efforts to apologize and make peace. ### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane.md)

### [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)
